name: Sawyer Products MINI Water Filtration System
spec_summary: 0.1 Micron absolute hollow fiber membrane filter rated for up to 100,000 gallons. Eliminates 99.99999% of bacteria (Salmonella, Cholera, E. coli) and 99.9999% of protozoa (Giardia, Cryptosporidium). Weight: 2 oz.
offline_specs: 0.1 Micron Absolute Hollow Fiber Membrane | 100,000 Gallon Lifespan | Weight: 2 oz (57g) | Exceeds EPA drinking water standards | Includes 16oz squeeze pouch & cleaning plunger.

name: Aquatabs 49mg Water Purification Tablets (100-Pack)
spec_summary: US EPA-registered effervescent water disinfectant (NaDCC). Destroys 99.9999% of bacteria, 99.99% of viruses, and 99.9% of cysts. Treats 1 to 2 liters per tablet within 30 minutes. 5-year hermetic foil shelf life.
offline_specs: Active Ingredient: Sodium Dichloroisocyanurate (NaDCC 49mg) | Quantity: 100 foil-wrapped tablets | Dosage: 1 tab per 1-2L (turbid) or 4L (clear) | Reaction Time: 30 minutes | WHO / EPA compliant.

name: North American Rescue Combat Application Tourniquet (CAT Gen 7)
spec_summary: Official CoTCCC-recommended arterial occlusion tourniquet. Engineered with a single-routing buckle, high-strength windlass rod, and dedicated white time-strap to halt life-threatening limb hemorrhage in under 60 seconds.
offline_specs: Windlass Arterial Occlusion System | Official CoTCCC Approved | White Writeable Time Strap (TIME: HH:MM) | Weight: 2.9 oz | True one-handed operational deployment.

name: QuikClot Advanced Clotting Gauze (3 in x 24 in, 2-Pack)
spec_summary: Kaolin-infused z-folded hemostatic gauze engineered to accelerate the natural clotting cascade without generating exothermic heat. Designed for deep wound packing in junctional groin and axillary trauma.
offline_specs: Active Agent: Inert Inorganic Kaolin | Size: 3 in x 24 in (7.6 cm x 61 cm) Z-Fold | Compression Time: 3 minutes direct manual pressure | Non-allergenic, non-exothermic | Vacuum sealed.

name: Emergency Hand Crank Solar Radio with NOAA/AM/FM & Flashlight
spec_summary: Autonomous multi-band emergency communications receiver featuring NOAA weather alerts, hand-crank dynamo, solar charging cell, 5,000mAh device power bank, and 3-mode LED tactical flashlight.
offline_specs: Bands: NOAA Weather (7 channels auto-alert), AM (520-1710 KHz), FM (87-108 MHz) | Power: Dynamo Crank, Solar, USB-C, 5000mAh Battery | 3W LED Flashlight & SOS Siren.

name: iOSAT Potassium Iodide Tablets 130 mg (14-Count Pack)
spec_summary: FDA-approved thyroid blocking agent preventing internal absorption of radioactive iodine-131 downwind of nuclear detonation or reactor breach. Single daily adult dosage provides full 24-hour thyroid saturation.
offline_specs: Dosage: 130 mg Potassium Iodide per tablet (FDA NDA 18-664) | Adult Dose: 1 tablet daily (130 mg) | Pediatric Dose: 65 mg (3-18 yrs), 32 mg (1 mo-3 yrs) | Shelf Life: 10+ years hermetic foil.

name: 5-Gallon Mylar Food Storage Bags (7-Mil Thick) + 2000cc Absorbers
spec_summary: Military-grade puncture-resistant 7-mil aluminum-laminated barrier bags paired with high-capacity 2,000cc oxygen absorbers. Guarantees zero oxygen transmission (OTR < 0.001) for 25+ year food stability.
offline_specs: Thickness: 7 Mil (180 microns) heavy-duty aluminum barrier | Dimensions: 19.5 x 28.5 inches | Oxygen Absorbers: 2,000cc iron-based scavengers | Target Residual O2: < 0.1% | Heat sealable at 375°F.

name: ReadyWise Emergency Food Supply 72-Hour Survival Kit (32 Servings)
spec_summary: Nutrient-dense emergency ration bucket providing 32 servings of freeze-dried and dehydrated meals. Delivers approx. 1,800–2,000 kcal per day for 72 hours. Stackable, grab-and-go water-resistant container with 25-year shelf life.
offline_specs: Servings: 32 Total Servings | Caloric Delivery: ~1,800 - 2,000 kcal/day | Preparation: Just add hot or room-temp water | Shelf Life: 25 Years unopened | Grab-and-go waterproof bucket.

name: Swiss Safe Emergency Mylar Thermal Blankets (Dual-Sided, 4-Pack)
spec_summary: Dual-sided aluminized space blankets engineered to reflect up to 90% of radiated body heat. Essential for preventing hypothermia in traumatic shock victims, extreme wilderness bivouacs, and emergency shelter insulation.
offline_specs: Material: Dual-Sided 12-Micron Metalized Polyethylene Mylar | Dimensions: 52 x 82 inches (132 x 208 cm) | Thermal Retention: 90% body heat reflection | Weight: 2 oz each | Hazard orange backing.
